verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה׀ שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ אֲבוֹתָ֑ם מָאַ֥סְתִּי לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם־ צֹאנִֽי׃ כַּלְבֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh śā·ḥă·qū ‘ā·lay ṣə·‘î·rîm mim·men·nî lə·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām mā·’as·tî lā·šîṯ ‘im- ṣō·nî kal·ḇê
verses.literal: But now they mock me . . . men younger than I am . . . whose fathers I would have refused to put with my sheep dogs

verses.original: גַּם־ לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם כָּֽלַח׃ אָ֣בַד
verses.transliteration: gam- lām·māh lî ‘ā·lê·mōw kō·aḥ yə·ḏê·hem kā·laḥ ’ā·ḇaḏ
verses.literal: - What use to me . . . was the strength of their hands since their vigor had left them

verses.original: גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן הַֽעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה׃ אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: gal·mūḏ bə·ḥe·ser ū·ḇə·ḵā·p̄ān ha·‘ō·rə·qîm ṣî·yāh šō·w·’āh ū·mə·šō·’āh ’e·meš
verses.literal: Gaunt from poverty and hunger they gnawed the dry land and the desolate wasteland by night

verses.original: הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי־ שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qō·ṭə·p̄îm mal·lū·aḥ ‘ă·lê- śî·aḥ wə·šō·reš rə·ṯā·mîm laḥ·mām
verses.literal: They plucked mallow among the shrubs and the roots of the broom tree were their food

verses.original: יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ מִן־ גֵּ֥ו יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḡō·rā·šū min- gêw yā·rî·‘ū ‘ā·lê·mōw kag·gan·nāḇ
verses.literal: They were banished from among [men] shouted at like thieves

verses.original: לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים וְכֵפִֽים׃ חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר
verses.transliteration: liš·kōn ba·‘ă·rūṣ nə·ḥā·lîm wə·ḵê·p̄îm ḥō·rê ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: so that they lived on the slopes of the wadis among the rocks and in holes in the ground

verses.original: יִנְהָ֑קוּ בֵּין־ שִׂיחִ֥ים יְסֻפָּֽחוּ׃ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל
verses.transliteration: yin·hā·qū bên- śî·ḥîm yə·sup·pā·ḥū ta·ḥaṯ ḥā·rūl
verses.literal: They cried out among the shrubs and huddled beneath the nettles

verses.original: נָ֭בָל בְּֽנֵי־ גַּם־ בְלִי־ שֵׁ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḇāl bə·nê- gam- ḇə·lî- šêm bə·nê nik·kə·’ū min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: A senseless and vvv nameless brood they were driven off the land

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה הָיִ֑יתִי נְגִינָתָ֣ם וָאֱהִ֖י לְמִלָּֽה׃ לָהֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hā·yî·ṯî nə·ḡî·nā·ṯām wā·’ĕ·hî lə·mil·lāh lā·hem
verses.literal: And now vvv they mock me in song I have become a byword among them

verses.original: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי לֹא־ חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק׃ וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י
verses.transliteration: ti·‘ă·ḇū·nî rā·ḥă·qū men·nî lō- ḥā·śə·ḵū rōq ū·mip·pā·nay
verses.literal: They abhor me and keep far from me they do not hesitate to spit in my face

verses.original: כִּֽי־ פִ֭תַּח יִתְרוֹ וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃ וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י
verses.transliteration: kî- p̄it·taḥ yiṯ·rō way·‘an·nê·nî šil·lê·ḥū wə·re·sen mip·pā·nay
verses.literal: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me they have cast off restraint in my presence

verses.original: פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ עַל־ יָמִין֮ שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ רַגְלַ֥י וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם׃ עָ֝לַ֗י
verses.transliteration: pir·ḥaḥ yā·qū·mū ‘al- yā·mîn šil·lê·ḥū raḡ·lay way·yā·sōl·lū ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ ’ê·ḏām ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: The rabble arises at my right they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps . . . against me

verses.original: נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לְהַוָּתִ֥י לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯə·sū nə·ṯî·ḇā·ṯî yō·‘î·lū lə·haw·wā·ṯî lō ‘ō·zêr lā·mōw
verses.literal: They tear up my path they profit from my destruction with no one to restrain them

verses.original: יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ רָחָ֣ב כְּפֶ֣רֶץ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yū rā·ḥāḇ kə·p̄e·reṣ ta·ḥaṯ šō·ʾāh hiṯ·gal·gā·lū
verses.literal: They advance as through a wide breach through the ruins they keep rolling in

verses.original: בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י תִּרְדֹּ֣ף נְדִבָתִ֑י כָּ֭רוּחַ יְשֻׁעָתִֽי׃ עָבְרָ֥ה וּ֝כְעָ֗ב
verses.transliteration: bal·lā·hō·wṯ hā·hə·paḵ ‘ā·lay tir·dōp̄ nə·ḏi·ḇā·ṯî kā·rū·aḥ yə·šu·‘ā·ṯî ‘ā·ḇə·rāh ū·ḵə·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Terrors are turned loose against me they drive away my dignity as by the wind and my prosperity has passed like a cloud

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֑י תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ עָ֭לַי יְמֵי־ עֹֽנִי׃ יֹ֭אחֲז֣וּנִי
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh nap̄·šî tiš·tap·pêḵ ‘ā·lay yə·mê- ‘ō·nî yō·ḥă·zū·nî
verses.literal: And now my soul is poured out within me days of affliction grip me

verses.original: לַ֗יְלָה נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י עֲ֭צָמַי וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: lay·lāh niq·qar mê·‘ā·lāy ‘ă·ṣā·may wə·‘ō·rə·qay lō yiš·kā·ḇūn
verses.literal: Night pierces . . . my bones and my gnawing pains never rest

verses.original: בְּרָב־ כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי׃ כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י
verses.transliteration: bə·rāḇ- kō·aḥ yiṯ·ḥap·pêś lə·ḇū·šî ya·’az·rê·nî kə·p̄î ḵut·tā·nə·tî
verses.literal: With great force He grasps my garment He seizes me by the collar of my tunic

verses.original: הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·rā·nî la·ḥō·mer wā·’eṯ·maš·šêl ke·‘ā·p̄ār wā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: He throws me into the mud and I have become like dust and ashes

verses.original: אֵ֭לֶיךָ אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·le·ḵā ’ă·šaw·wa‘ wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·nê·nî ‘ā·maḏ·tî wat·tiṯ·bō·nen bî
verses.literal: I cry out to You for help but You do not answer when I stand up You merely look at me

verses.original: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי׃ בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣
verses.transliteration: tê·hā·p̄êḵ lə·’aḵ·zār lî ṯiś·ṭə·mê·nî bə·‘ō·ṣem yā·ḏə·ḵā
verses.literal: You have ruthlessly turned on me You oppose me with Your strong hand

verses.original: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי תְּשֻׁוֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: tiś·śā·’ê·nî ’el- rū·aḥ tar·kî·ḇê·nî ū·ṯə·mō·ḡə·ḡê·nî tə·šuw·wɛh
verses.literal: You snatch me up into the wind and drive me [before it] You toss me about in the storm

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָ֭דַעְתִּי תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי מָ֣וֶת וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכָל־ חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·ḏa‘·tî tə·šî·ḇê·nî mā·weṯ ū·ḇêṯ mō·w·‘êḏ lə·ḵāl ḥāy
verses.literal: Yes I know that You will bring me down [to] death to the place appointed for all the living

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֹא־ יִשְׁלַח־ יָ֑ד בְ֭עִי אִם־ שֽׁוּעַ׃ בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō- yiš·laḥ- yāḏ ḇə·‘î ’im- šū·a‘ bə·p̄î·ḏōw lā·hen
verses.literal: Yet no one stretches out his hand against a ruined man when he cries for help in his distress . . .

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־ י֑וֹם נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י עָֽגְמָ֥ה לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ḇā·ḵî·ṯî liq·šêh- yō·wm nap̄·šî ‘ā·ḡə·māh lā·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: - Have I not wept for those in trouble . . . Has my soul not grieved for the needy

verses.original: כִּ֤י קִ֭וִּיתִי ט֣וֹב רָ֑ע וַיָּ֣בֹא וַֽאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר אֹֽפֶל׃ וַיָּ֥בֹא
verses.transliteration: kî qiw·wî·ṯî ṭō·wḇ rā‘ way·yā·ḇō wa·’ă·ya·ḥă·lāh lə·’ō·wr ’ō·p̄el way·yā·ḇō
verses.literal: But when I hoped for good evil came when I looked for light darkness fell

verses.original: רֻתְּח֥וּ מֵעַ֖י וְלֹא־ דָ֗מּוּ יְמֵי־ עֹֽנִי׃ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי
verses.transliteration: rut·tə·ḥū mê·‘ay wə·lō- ḏām·mū yə·mê- ‘ō·nî qid·də·mu·nî
verses.literal: I am churning within and cannot rest days of affliction confront me

verses.original: הִ֭לַּכְתִּי קֹדֵ֣ר בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: hil·laḵ·tî qō·ḏêr bə·lō ḥam·māh qam·tî ḇaq·qā·hāl ’ă·šaw·wê·a‘
verses.literal: I go about blackened but not by the sun I stand up in the assembly and cry for help

verses.original: הָיִ֣יתִי אָ֭ח לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·ṯî ’āḥ lə·ṯan·nîm wə·rê·a‘ liḇ·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: I have become a brother of jackals a companion vvv of ostriches

verses.original: ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מִנִּי־ מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי־ חָ֝֗רָה חֹֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·rî šā·ḥar min·nî- mê·‘ā·lāy wə·‘aṣ·mî- ḥā·rāh ḥō·reḇ
verses.literal: My skin grows black and peels . . . and my bones burn with fever

verses.original: כִּנֹּרִ֑י וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kin·nō·rî way·hî lə·’ê·ḇel wə·‘u·ḡā·ḇî lə·qō·wl bō·ḵîm
verses.literal: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping
